name: Awake NY x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Boro - Racer Blue'
story_html: The Awake NY x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Boro - Racer Blue' reunites the partner brands on a reimagined AJ5, featuring a black tumbled leather upper with contrast white stitching and 'Nike Air' on the back heel. A cut-out in the quarter panel netting forms Awake NY's 'A' logo, while dual Awake NY and Jumpman branding graces the silver reflective tongue in Racer Blue embroidery. 'NY' and '23' are embroidered on the lateral heel of the right and left shoe, respectively.
